items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Bill Johnson -- trombone. [INTERVIEWEE] Trombone -- from Detroit.

ctx.x: Well, Stanley, so -- once Walter Page and Jo Jones were back -- read us off the line-up of the band there, will you?
Ed Lewis, Harry Edison, Snooky Young, Emmett Berry. Bill Johnson -- trombone.
